newsitem.title: UK: RESEARCH ALERT - Unilever raised to buy at CSFB.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Unilever raised to buy at CSFB.

text.p: Anglo-Dutch consumer products group Unilever Plc/NV was raised to a "buy" rating from "hold" at CSFB, the investment bank said on Monday.
Analyst Anne Alexandre said she had raised her price target to 550 guilders from 450 guilders in Amsterdam trading.
By 0947 GMT, Unilever shares gained 6.10 guilders to 473.50. In London, the stock was up 11p at 18.32-1/2 stg.
Unilever management has added credibility after delivering on improved operating margins in the second quarter, Alexandre said.
"After the rapid disposal of the speciality chemicals business, this performance is additional evidence that Unilever is effectively restructuring," Alexandre said.
"With potentially $15 billion to spend over the next two to three years, we now believe that Unilever is in a position to give extra momentum to its growth."

Unilever on Friday announed an unexpected 24 percent leap in its half-year profits to 1.374 billion pounds, excluding profits from the sale of its speciality chemicals business to Imperial Chemical Industries Plc for $8 billion in early July.
Margins in Europe climbed 12 percent in the second quarter, up from 9.5 percent over the same period last year.
